analysis: Retain every scan-label row and report missing rows without imputation.
Report per-label minimum, median, and maximum component counts for both connectivities.
Report the largest-component fraction to distinguish small disconnected islands from dominant components.
Treat all outputs as source-label topology only; never infer lumen continuity or Numi subject binding.
evidence_boundary: Automatic CT source-mask connectivity only. No clinical segmentation review, vascular lumen, skin layer, subject registration, physical volume owner, mechanics, or physiology is qualified.
experimental_unit: one source scan and one registered source label ID
predictions: For every measured row, full26 component count is no greater than face6 component count.
Aorta and VCI masks will each be one full26-connected component in at least 27 of 30 scans.
Heart, bladder, liver, pancreas, spleen, and thyroid masks will each be one full26-connected component in at least 27 of 30 scans.
Aggregate kidneys and lung masks will each have one or two full26-connected components in at least 27 of 30 scans.
Psoas, combined skeletal muscle, subcutaneous fat, and torso fat are descriptive; no single-component expectation is imposed.
question: How many face-connected and corner-inclusive voxel components occur for each selected organ, vessel, and soft-tissue source label in each of the 30 independent CT segmentation scans?
stop_rule: Stop the single full-cohort run on the first archive, member-hash, array-shape, affine, voxel-count, source-code, or component-order invariant failure. Retain the failure and do not filter, overwrite, or rerun under this plan.
validity_checks: Whole archive byte count and SHA-256 match the registered intake.
Each selected NIfTI member uncompressed SHA-256 matches its intake row.
Each NIfTI array shape, affine source, and RAS affine match the intake.
Every selected mask voxel count redecoded from the source member matches its intake count.
No scan or selected label is dropped from the 30 by 15 census.
Each full26 component count is no greater than the corresponding face6 count.
